text.tspan: The hammer holds — but 27 findings weigh it down.
Job `test` pipes the test command into another tool without `set
FALSE-GREEN — In a shell pipeline only the last command's exit
code counts — a failing test run is masked by the downstream tool
Add `shell: bash` with `set -o pipefail`, or split into two steps
so the test command's exit code is preserved.
Re-run mjolnir after the change — the gate should stop failing and
Job `deploy-smoke` sequences commands with `; ` after the test
command — the test result does not fail the step.
FALSE-GREEN — With `;` sequencing the step's exit status comes
from the last command only, so failed tests still yield a green
Chain with `&&` instead of `;` so a test failure fails the step.
